title: Module 2 check: logic and number systems

questions.explanation: 89 = 64 + 16 + 8 + 1, so the 64, 16, 8 and 1 places hold 1s: 101 1001 (2#0101_1001 as eight bits).
250 ÷ 16 = 15 remainder 10. 15 is F and 10 is A, so 250 is 16#FA. Check: 15 × 16 + 10 = 250.

questions.prompt: A module reports the status word `16#1A4`. What is it in decimal?
Write 59 in BCD, four bits per digit.
questions.explanation: Each digit gets its own four bits: 5 = 0101 and 9 = 1001, so 59 is 0101 1001.

questions.prompt: Three thumbwheel switches send the BCD bits 0110 0000 0100. What number is dialed?
questions.explanation: Read each group of four as one digit: 0110 = 6, 0000 = 0, 0100 = 4, so 604.

questions.prompt: In plain binary, 16 bits hold 0 to 65,535. Why do the same 16 bits in BCD hold only 0 to 9,999?
options: Each group of four bits holds only one digit, 0 to 9; the codes 1010 to 1111 are never used
BCD uses one of the 16 bits for the sign
BCD needs 8 bits for each digit
questions.explanation: Four bits have sixteen codes but BCD uses only ten of them, so 16 bits make four digits: 0000 to 9999.

questions.prompt: Match each logic operation to the contacts that make it in a ladder rung.

pairs.right: Contacts in series, one after the other
Contacts in parallel, side by side

questions.explanation: In series, power must pass every contact (AND); in parallel, any path will do (OR); a normally closed contact passes power while its tag is FALSE (NOT).

questions.prompt: The horn sounds if the tank level is high **or** someone presses Test. A **normally open** contact of each tag is used. How are the two contacts wired?
options: Test as a normally closed contact in series with High
questions.explanation: Either condition alone sounds the horn, so this is OR: contacts in parallel.

questions.prompt: *The conveyor runs in two cases: when Run is on and the jam sensor is not blocked; or, on its own, while Jog is held.* The jam sensor's tag Jam is TRUE when blocked. Which expression says this?
questions.explanation: "Run is on and the jam sensor is not blocked" is Run AND NOT Jam, one condition in brackets; Jog alone also runs it: (Run AND NOT Jam) OR Jog.

questions.prompt: Mind the order of operations: fill in A AND B OR NOT C.
questions.expression: A AND B OR NOT C
questions.explanation: NOT first, then AND, then OR: (A AND B) OR (NOT C). TRUE whenever C is FALSE, and on the row where A, B and C are all TRUE.
